value.headline: NOR edges it
value.summary: North America’s Max Verstappen (VER) was out-performed by Fernando Alonso (NOR) in the single Australian Grand Prix, with NOR taking the win (1-0 head-to-head) and finishing five places ahead of VER (5 vs 6). Alonso also beat Verstappen in qualifying by six places (6 vs 20), managed tyres better (-0.083 s/lap vs -0.012 s/lap) and secured the better overall result (5 vs 6 places). Verstappen’s only edges were in overtaking (10 vs 4 passes), positions gained (14 vs 1 place) and a slightly quicker peak lap (82.091 s vs 82.358 s). The comparison is based on just one race, so it reflects a snapshot rather than a reliable trend.
caveats: One race only: a snapshot, not a trend.
value.rule_summary: NOR leads on head-to-head, qualifying, tyre management, result, most clearly on head-to-head (1 wins). VER answers on overtaking, positions gained, peak pace. Across 1 race: head-to-head 0-1, VER faster by 0.032s per lap on average, points 8-1.
